Think of Igloo Core Engine like an operating system for immersive spaces. It can power any shared immersive space irrespective of size, shape, configuration, or display technology - and it's also great for any other large format displays. Igloo Core Engine takes the complexity out of building, operating and benefiting from shared immersive spaces. And, we've recently evolved Igloo Core Engine with our largest software update yet, Igloo Core Engine 2.0. Discover Igloo Core Engine 2.0 Igloo Core Engine makes it easy to operate immersive spaces We created Igloo Core Engine with the everyday user of digital content in mind, and offer a choice of interfaces - so, if you can use a phone or a PC, you can operate an Igloo-powered immersive space. It is the oldest university in Wales, with its Lampeter campus opening in 1822, birthing higher education in the country. The University also boasts the oldest Royal Charter of any university in Wales, having been decreed in 1822. In 2010, the University was renamed to the University of Wales Trinity Saint David, following a merger with Trinity University College. It now spans three campuses, serving over 15,000 students. True to its aims of transforming education and a far cry from the technology of the days it was created, UWTSD has invested in two ultra-high-end Samsung LED solutions, integrated by IDNS and powered by Igloo Core Engine, to provide bleeding-edge educational experiences to its students. At a glance After implementing Igloo Core Engine into its immersive space, UWTSD has seen: Over 12,000 students and 85 courses using the space during the academic year 2025/26 from September to May. 1,900 hours of in-space teaching to help achieve teaching and learning objectives 294 external sessions, including visits and demonstrations, bringing together both prospective students and local and national organisations into the immersive environment. The product UWTSD opted for two state-of-the-art Samsung LED solutions with 18-metre screens, purposefully designed to provide maximum engagement and motivation for students. An LED solution was chosen primarily for the visual experience, with enhanced brightness and clarity and without the shadowing that can arise on projection-based systems when people stand near the edges of the space. Additionally, LED systems can be repaired on-site with targeted local repairs that don't require whole-screen replacement. Each screen is capable of High Dynamic Range for maximum colour clarity and a vivid image, bringing the content to life.
